\begin{frame}{Policies}

\vfill
\begin{itemize}
\item []\textbf{Attendance}

\begin{itemize}
\item Come to class.
\item $2.5\%$ will be deducted for each absence over $5$.
\end{itemize}
\item []\textbf{Make-ups}

\begin{itemize}
\item At least $2$ will be dropped.
\item No make-ups for HW/quizzes.
\item A missed exam will count as the lowest exam to be replaced by the
final. 
\item If you know you will miss an exam, schedule to take it at a different
time.
\end{itemize}

\begin{frame}{WebAssign}

A \emph{WebAssign }account is required for this course. To setup an
account complete the following:
\begin{enumerate}
\item Go to the website \href{http://www.webassign.net/}{www.webassign.net}.
In the upper right corner is a gray box, \href{http://www.webassign.net/v4cgi/selfenroll/classkey.html}{$ \begin{array}{l} \includegraphics[height=12pt,keepaspectratio=true]{/home/jim/JamesAshe/MHU/MHU_Finite_Math/WebAssign_Enter_Class_Key.png}
\end{array}$}; click on it.
\item Enter the code for your section. 
\item Follow the step-by-step instructions. If you have used \emph{WebAssign
}before, use your existing account. If you are creating a new account,
use last name dot first name (example: John Smith would have username
smith.john).
\item \uline{Add your email address the first time you logo in}. Use your
MHU email account if possible.
\end{enumerate}
